title: Polynomial-size tree-AC language
statement: A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet belongs to tree-AC at depth parameter $d$ if there is a family of Boolean tree circuits of polynomial size, with polylogarithmic depth parameterized by $d$, whose accepted language is exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
